label: Landing
contract: The quest, not the worker, waits for its submitted change to land through the landing queue. Takode adds this phase when Work hands a submitted change to Memory, moves the quest here when final Memory completes, records the landed commits as the quest's code evidence and completes the quest. A bounced or withdrawn change keeps the quest here until the leader routes the fix into its next Work occurrence.
nextLeaderAction: nothing while the change waits or lands; Takode completes the quest when it lands. When it bounces, decide who fixes it and when, then advance into the next Work occurrence
